title: Consultant- Kotlin
description:
We are looking for an experienced and passionate **Kotlin Engineer** to join our core engineering team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, building, and optimizing highly scalable backend systems and microservices using Kotlin in a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environment. You will work within an agile, cross-functional team, taking ownership of critical infrastructure that handles high-throughput and massive scale.

If you thrive in a "you build it, you run it" culture and want to leverage modern cloud-native architectures to solve complex business challenges, we want to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Backend Development:** Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance, and scalable backend services primarily using Kotlin and frameworks like Spring Boot or Ktor.

* **Cloud Architecture:** Build, deploy, and operate cloud-native applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), utilizing services such as Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, Cloud Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, and BigQuery.

* **System Design & Scale:** Architect fault-tolerant distributed systems capable of handling thousands of concurrent requests with low latency and high availability.

* **Data Engineering & Storage:** Optimize data storage and retrieval patterns using relational (Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (Firestore, MongoDB) databases, as well as distributed caching solutions (Redis).

* **Code Quality & Mentorship:** Drive engineering best practices, conduct rigorous code reviews, ensure comprehensive test coverage, and mentor mid-level and junior engineers on technical excellence.

* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Partner with Product Managers, Frontend Engineers, and Data Scientists to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 4 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend system development.

* **Kotlin Expertise:** Hands-on, production-level experience developing in Kotlin. Deep understanding of Kotlin coroutines, modern asynchronous programming, and JVM performance optimization.

* **Cloud Proficiency (GCP):** Solid practical experience designing, securing, and operating distributed services natively on Google Cloud Platform.

* **Microservices & APIs:** Proven track record of building and integrating RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event-driven microservices architectures.

* **Containerization:** Experience deploying and managing containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

* **Problem Solving:** Excellent debugging skills and a systematic approach to troubleshooting complex distributed system issues.

title: iOS Developer
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Fresher iOS Developer** to join our development team. The candidate will work on building, testing, and maintaining iOS applications while learning and applying modern iOS development practices.

Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain iOS applications using **Swift** and **Xcode**.
* Build user\-friendly interfaces using **UIKit and/or SwiftUI**.
* Work with **REST APIs** and integrate backend services.
* Implement application features based on business and technical requirements.
* Debug issues and fix bugs to improve application performance and stability.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code.
* Perform testing and support application releases.
* Collaborate with designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and other team members.
* Stay updated with the latest iOS development technologies and best practices.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **Swift**.
* Familiarity with **Xcode** and iOS development.
* Understanding of **UIKit or SwiftUI**.
* Basic knowledge of **REST APIs and JSON**.
* Understanding of **Git/GitHub**.
* Knowledge of object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Basic understanding of iOS application lifecycle and debugging.
* Good problem\-solving and communication skills.

Good to Have

* Personal or academic iOS projects.
* Knowledge of **Core Data, URLSession, or Firebase**.
* Familiarity with **MVVM or other design patterns**.
* Knowledge of App Store submission and TestFlight.
* Internship or project experience in iOS development.

Education

**B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / equivalent degree** in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on real\-world iOS applications.
* Mentorship from experienced developers.
* Exposure to modern iOS technologies.
* Learning and career\-growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.

Pay: Up to ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
